correctness.rationale: The symmetrization lemma is sound: for any Hilbert positive quadratic comparison Q, averaging mQ≤||x||p²≤MQ over all S3 permutations maintains m,M and forces scalar Euclidean Q on H by its 120° rotation. Each nonzero real zero-sum triple reduces by permutation/scalar to (1,r,-1-r), 0≤r≤1. F_p(r)=(1+r^p+(1+r)^p)^(1/p)/sqrt(2(1+r+r²)); for 1<p<infinity its log-derivative has sign of G_r(s)=(2+r)r^s+(1-r)(1+r)^s-(1+2r), s=p-1. G_r(1)=G_r(3)=0 and G_r''(s)>0 for 0<r<1, giving monotonicity with precisely p=2,4 transitions. Explicit p1 and p∞ expressions increase; endpoints Fp(0), Fp(1) yield the exact reciprocal-max formula and p∞ 2/sqrt3. At p=4, exact polynomial identity 2Σxi^4=(Σxi²)² on H confirms d=1. All-real-p proof is analytic, not finite experiments; no optimal tilted ellipse is omitted.
